adds.rationale: The watchlist has zero exposure to robotics, the profile's #2 named next wave, and industry capital is visibly flowing into the space (Amazon's pending $1.7B iRobot acquisition, still unresolved as of Q4 2022); BOTZ is a long-established, liquid, diversified vehicle to open that exposure now rather than chase a single name.

adds.rationale: Planet Labs is a commercial-milestone-backed second name in the rockets & spacecraft bucket (satellite services, the specific sub-theme the profile names), complementing launch-provider RKLB with satellite-imagery/data recurring revenue that is accelerating into year-end.

news_evidence.summary: Planet Labs reported record Q3 FY23 (quarter ended Oct 31, 2022) revenue of $49.7M, up 57% YoY, beating estimates; shares rose on the print

Planet Labs raised full-year FY23 revenue guidance to $188-192M (~45% YoY growth at midpoint) and ended the quarter with $425M in cash and short-term investments, citing government-segment momentum and new commercial partnerships

removes.rationale: A founder/CEO resignation paired with a financial restatement and delayed quarterly filing is a governance and accounting thesis-breach in a still pre-revenue, speculative quantum name; IONQ remains as cleaner exposure to the same wave.

news_evidence.summary: Founder Dr. Chad Rigetti announced his resignation as President, CEO, and Director effective ~Dec 15, 2022; interim CEO named pending a permanent successor search

rationale_overall: Net effect: watchlist grows from 14 to 15 tickers (still under the 16 cap), opening a first position in the robotics bucket (BOTZ) that had zero representation despite being the profile's #2 named next wave, and adding a second rockets/spacecraft name (PL) whose satellite-data revenue is accelerating alongside RKLB's launch business, both consistent with 'enter during the buildup.' One quantum-bucket name (RGTI) is removed on a governance/accounting thesis breach (founder-CEO exit plus a financial restatement), leaving IONQ as the cleaner quantum exposure. AI mega-caps (AAPL/MSFT/GOOGL/NVDA), SPY, defense (LMT/ITA), nuclear (SMR/LEU), tankers (STNG), and healthcare/demographics (ISRG) are kept unchanged: Q4 2022 news for each shows ongoing wave strength or normal noise, not a breach, despite 2022's broad market drawdown (S&P -19.4% for the year) which is macro, not stock-specific.
